create_convnet_model: create a ConvNet model with specified height, width, and output channels for image classification
run_convnet_forward: run a forward pass through the ConvNet model on an input tensor
build_convnet_no_bias: build a ConvNet model with bias disabled in the linear layer
infer_conv_output_shape: infer the output shape of a convolutional layer given input shape, kernel size, stride, and padding
test_convnet_optimizer: test an optimizer using the ConvNet model for image classification tasks
